import json, pathlib, re, hashlib, difflib

root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/work/w7-resume')

p=next(x for x in packages if 'icp' in x['archive'])

tree={x['path']:x for x in json.loads((root/'icp-tree.json').read_text())['tree']}
checks=[]
def check(name,ok):
    checks.append({'name':name,'result':'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'})
    assert ok,name
    print('PASS '+name)

    members[name]=json.loads(p['members'][name]); check('parse '+name,isinstance(members[name],dict))
j=members['plugin.json']; e=j['extensions']['com.openai']; i=e['interface']
check('package and current source version unchanged',j['version']==json.loads((repo/'package.json').read_text())['version']=='1.2.26')

check('starter and capability limits',len(i['defaultPrompt'])==3 and len(set(i['defaultPrompt']))==3 and all(len(s)<=128 and '\n' not in s and '@' not in s for s in i['defaultPrompt']) and all(len(s)<=120 for s in i['capabilities']))
check('remote server has no auth or shell declaration',list(members['mcp.json']['mcpServers'].values())==[{'type':'streamable-http','url':'https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp'}] and 'skills' not in j)
check('listing URLs use expected HTTPS hosts',all(i[k].startswith('https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/') for k in ['websiteURL','privacyPolicyURL','termsOfServiceURL']) and i['supportURL']=='https://gtmhelix.com/lets-get-started/')
check('five positive and three negative fixtures',len(e['review']['test_cases']['positive'])==5 and len(e['review']['test_cases']['negative'])==3)
def validate(schema,value,path='root'):
    kind=schema.get('type')
    if kind=='object':
        assert isinstance(value,dict),path
        assert set(schema.get('required',[]))<=set(value),path
        for k,v in value.items():
            assert k in schema.get('properties',{}),path+'.'+k
            validate(schema['properties'][k],v,path+'.'+k)
    elif kind=='array':
        assert isinstance(value,list),path
        for v in value: validate(schema['items'],v,path+'[]')
    elif kind=='string': assert isinstance(value,str),path
    elif kind in ['integer','number']:
        assert isinstance(value,(int,float)) and not isinstance(value,bool),path
        if 'minimum' in schema: assert value>=schema['minimum'],path
        if 'maximum' in schema: assert value<=schema['maximum'],path
    if 'enum' in schema: assert value in schema['enum'],path
for t in e['review']['test_cases']['positive']:
    args=json.loads(t['prompt'].split('\n',1)[1])
    validate(inventory['current'][t['tools_triggered']]['inputSchema'],args)
    check('source schema accepts fixture '+t['tools_triggered'],True)

check('account priority reference arithmetic',80*.4+60*.3+40*.15+100*.15==71 and 60*.4+50*.3+20*.15+40*.15==48)

(root/'icp-source-review-20261029.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n')
